    app = adsk.core.Application.get()
    doc = app.activeDocument
    
    # Find the Design product (not the CAM product)
    design = None
    for product in doc.products:
        if type(product).__name__ == 'Design':
            design = adsk.fusion.Design.cast(product)
            break
    
    if design is None:
        print("No Design product found!")
        # Try casting differently
        for product in doc.products:
            print(f"  Product: {type(product).__name__}, objectType: {product.objectType}")
    else:
        print(f"Design found: {design.rootComponent.name}")
        # Get the body
        root = design.rootComponent
        body = root.bodies.item(0)
        print(f"Body: {body.name}, faces: {body.faces.count}")
        
        # Get face 9 (hole cylindrical face) and face 2 (bottom face with hole)
        face9 = body.faces.item(9)
        face2 = body.faces.item(2)
        print(f"Face 9: type={face9.geometry.classType() if face9 else 'None'}")
        print(f"Face 2: type={face2.geometry.classType() if face2 else 'None'}")
        
        # Now set the holeFaces parameter on the Spot Drill operation
        cam = mb.get_cam()
        setup = cam.setups.itemByName("Setup1")
        op = setup.operations.itemByName("Spot Drill")
        
        # Find the holeFaces parameter
        for i in range(op.parameters.count):
            param = op.parameters.item(i)
            if param.name == "holeFaces":
                print(f"\nFound holeFaces parameter")
                val = param.value
                print(f"Value type: {type(val).__name__}")
                
                # Try to set the value with face 9
                # CadObjectParameterValue.value is a BaseVector
                # We need to add the face to this vector
                try:
                    # Create a new vector with the face
                    faces_list = adsk.core.ObjectCollection.create()
